parent_objective: run source smoke for a retuned staged warmup gate that targets clear near-boundary rows
blocked_by: M1414 admits source smoke only before outcome probing
supersedes: rerunning M1410 source smoke without retuning
running outcome probe before retargeted source viability is known

public_gates: M1415 must run no-training source smoke only
M1415 must report source, warmup evidence, and invasiveness metrics
M1415 must not run outcome interventions, train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune only the 3 M1412 accepted-history seeds
do not claim level3 self-identification from source materialization

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the retuned staged warmup gate can preserve source diversity and warmup evidence while reducing collision pressure
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training source smoke only; no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if matched/bucketed rows are sparse
stop if collision share remains too high
stop if actor input changes are required
fallback_plan: route to gate retune audit if collision share remains high
route to outcome probe if source diversity, warmup evidence, and invasiveness gates pass
route to branch synthesis if retargeted source remains sparse

training_stage.stage_objective: clear near-boundary staged warmup retarget source smoke
admission_evidence: M1412 sparse positives were not collision-only but need better source distribution
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: warmup evidence and collision share are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1415 is source smoke only and cannot claim history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No-training source smoke following M1414 design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source viability or invasiveness gates fail, record the failure and audit before outcome probing.
allowed_claims: no outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The retuned staged warmup gate can preserve source diversity and warmup command-response evidence while reducing collision pressure enough to justify a later outcome probe.
success_criteria: source diversity and warmup evidence metrics meet the M1414 design thresholds or fail cleanly
result chooses next route without outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: result routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion

commands.name: retarget_source_smoke
commands.command: create retargeted configs and run no-training source smoke

decision_rule: M1415 passes structurally if it runs a no-training source smoke with source diversity, warmup evidence, and collision diagnostics before any outcome probing.
